g.text: Curves: 101 fixed thresholds, 0–1 units. Δ = GEQ Full − matching GMR; G1/G3 means use τ = .4/.5/.6; pp = percentage points.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #475569

g.text: Oracle envelope: GT presence with each method’s fixed candidates; diagnostic only. Test never selects checkpoints or thresholds.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #475569

g.text: One seed per experiment; curves show threshold sensitivity, not run uncertainty. Protocol groups are not a controlled cross-backbone ranking.
